# tool-permission-policy

> Declarative allow, ask and deny policies for agent tool calls: tool name globs, argument constraints on paths, hosts, values and numbers, context conditions and fail-closed deny. Python package `trysac-tool-permission-policy`, import name `tool_permission_policy`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [README](README.md): problem, installation, usage, public API, limits

- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and validation limits
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): test file and what it covers
